svg.title: Callouts from the AnuPpuccin theme
svg.desc: The locally installed AnuPpuccin CSS is loaded in its dark Mocha mode. The plugin's real theme scanner, overlay reconciliation, and appearance probe derive the read-only theme rows; the actual settings controller renders their measured colors and icons.

text.font-family: "??", "??", "??", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, "system-ui", system-ui, "Segoe UI", "Google Sans Flex", Roboto, "Inter Variable", Inter, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", sans-serif

"??", "??", "??", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, "system-ui", system-ui, "Segoe UI", "Google Sans Flex", Roboto, "Inter Variable", Inter, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", sans-serif

g.text: AnuPpuccin supplies or restyles these, so Callout Studio leaves them exactly as your theme draws them and offers them as Block callouts

g.text: only. Both kinds appear here: callout types your theme adds, and built-in callouts whose look it replaces. Callout types your theme adds
